title: UAP craft manipulate a subquantum information domain (Frieden's Fisher information)

tellings.quote: >> Right. I think what's happening is is I think the UAP craft are manipulating the uh the information domain because I think that there's a subquantum domain of information.

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist described as a Pentagon scientist, says he thinks UAP craft (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs) work by manipulating information at a level deeper than quantum physics. He bases this on the work of Roy Frieden of the University of Arizona, who wrote two books on Fisher information, a mathematical way of measuring how much information something carries. If he's right, these craft would be bending the basic rules of reality, not just flying with better engines.
